sql.if: join activity a on a.id = r.activity_id

mapper.select:
select count(*) as total, sum(case when r.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as signed_up, sum(case when r.status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as checked, sum(case when r.status = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as canceled, sum(case when r.status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) as absent, sum(case when r.status = 5 then 1 else 0 end) as pending from activity_registration r
where 1 = 1

select count(*) as total, coalesce(avg(rv.score), 0) as avg_score from activity_review rv
join activity a on a.id = rv.activity_id
where 1 = 1
and a.organizer_id = #{organizerId}

select c.id as category_id, c.name as name, (select count(*) from activity a where a.category_id = c.id and a.status <> 0 and a.organizer_id = #{organizerId} ) as activity_count, (select count(*) from activity_registration r join activity a2 on a2.id = r.activity_id where a2.category_id = c.id and r.status in (1, 2, 4) and a2.organizer_id = #{organizerId} ) as registration_count from activity_category c order by registration_count desc, c.id asc

select r.signup_time as signup_time, r.checkin_time as checkin_time from activity_registration r
join activity a on a.id = r.activity_id
where (r.signup_time >= #{start} or r.checkin_time >= #{start})
and a.organizer_id = #{organizerId}
